name: Oleander Brideman
source:
Melissa’s blood-related older brother. He is very protective of her, but slightly sadistic and teasing towards her as well. Their parents separated when they were young, and they were forced to live apart for most of their lives, but now they are very close. 

Oleander is bright, with a seemingly sunny personality, but he is also cunning, jealous, and rigid in his thinking. Like his sister, he is easily discouraged. He has a playful cruelty to him, that can easily turn into true malice. Groom.
